items.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
items.summary: The approved proposal doubles Solana’s annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, reducing future SOL issuance while leaving its long-term inflation target unchanged.

items.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
items.summary: Solana's first network-wide vote went down to the wire, with Kraken and Galaxy-linked validators switching sides before the disinflation proposal narrowly passed.

items.title: Solana Is Having Its Best Month Since 2024—With a Historic Governance Vote on Deck
items.summary: Solana is up more than 8% in 24 hours and 44% on the month. Coming changes to the network could add a supply squeeze to the mix.

items.title: New Solana vote could ramp daily SOL burns to $800,000 and slow new token creation
items.summary: Two of the three proposals would reduce SOL supply growth by speeding up Solana’s inflation decline and raising daily fee burns from about 650 SOL to as much as 9,000 SOL.
